description: Decode a Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) to get full vehicle specifications. Returns year, make, model, trim, body style, engine specs (cylinders, displacement, HP), drivetrain, transmission, fuel type, doors, manufacturer, and assembly plant location. Use this for 'decode this VIN', 'what car is this VIN?', 'look up a VIN number', 'what are the specs on this vehicle?', 'identify this car', or any VIN lookup. Works for all US vehicles - cars, trucks, SUVs, motorcycles, trailers.
name: vin_decode
